newsitem.title: EGYPT: Fertiliser firm approves 4.00 pound div.
newsitem.headline: Fertiliser firm approves 4.00 pound div.

text.p: Shareholders in fertiliser company Egyptian Financial and Industrial approved an annual dividend of 4.00 pounds for 1995/6 on Monday, as offered by the board.
The board had originally decided on 3.60 pounds but raised the offer when net profits rose more than 125 percent.

A member of the board said after-tax profits in the first five months of 1996/7, which started on July 1, rose to 19.6 million pounds ($5.8 million) from 12.2 million in the same period of the previous year.
Net after-tax profits for the whole of 1995/6 were 25.037 million pounds, up from 11.129 million in 1994/5.
The company has 3.249 million shares. The share price closed on Monday at 88.00 pounds, unchanged from Sunday.
